title: G3.4: durable, migration-free enrichment cancellation with a compare-and-swap on the job row; remove the dead in-memory cancellation map
interface: No migration, RPC, or new column: `cancelled` already exists for both lf_enrichment_jobs and lf_enrichment_batches (migration 027). (1) DELETE handler in app/api/lead-finder/campaigns/[id]/enrich/route.ts (~:88-100), after the existing org-scoped campaign check, using the existing user-scoped `supabase` (RLS permits org updates on both tables): (a) `const { data: batches } = await supabase.from("lf_enrichment_batches").select("id").eq("campaign_id", id).eq("organization_id", orgId).in("status", ["queued","running","paused"])`; (b) if batchIds non-empty, FIRST `supabase.from("lf_enrichment_jobs").update({ status: "cancelled", finished_at: nowIso }).eq("organization_id", orgId).in("batch_id", batchIds).in("status", ["queued","retry","running"])`, THEN `supabase.from("lf_enrichment_batches").update({ status: "cancelled", finished_at: nowIso }).eq("organization_id", orgId).in("id", batchIds).in("status", ["queued","running","paused"])` (jobs before batches so a crash between the two never leaves a claimable job under an open batch). Check the error of every DB call and return 500 on error. (c) keep the existing lf_leads enriching->new reset; remove the `cancelEnrichment` import/call; add `cancelledJobs` to the JSON response. (2) lib/lead-finder/enrichment/pipeline.ts `enrichSingleLead`: add optional `options.jobId?: string` and change the return type to `Promise<{ persisted: boolean }>`. Immediately after `analyzeEnrichmentData` returns and BEFORE the lf_lead_personalization upsert: if `options.jobId` is set, run `const { data: claimed } = await createAdminClient().from("lf_enrichment_jobs").update({ status: "done", finished_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq("id", options.jobId).in("status", ["running", "retry"]).select("id")`; if `!claimed || claimed.length === 0` return `{ persisted: false }` without touching lf_lead_personalization or lf_leads. (`retry` is accepted only because recoverStaleRunning can flip a still-executing job to retry after 10 minutes; `cancelled`, `done`, `failed` are never accepted.) The CAS MUST use createAdminClient (cron/worker context has no user session). Wrap the personalization upsert + lf_leads update that follow in try/catch: on error run `createAdminClient().from("lf_enrichment_jobs").update({ status: "failed", last_error: String(err).slice(0, 500) }).eq("id", options.jobId).eq("status", "done")` then rethrow. Return `{ persisted: true }` on success. Delete `activeCancellations`, `cancellationKey`, `cancelEnrichment`, `isCancelled`, `clearCancellation` and the `clearCancellation(...)` call (~:233). The other caller app/api/lead-finder/leads/[id]/enrich/route.ts passes no jobId and may ignore the return value. (3) lib/lead-finder/enrichment/worker.ts: failJob (~:410-420) and retryJob (~:428-438) add `.eq("status", "running")` directly after `.eq("id", job.id)`; processJob passes `jobId: job.id` in the enrichSingleLead options, captures `const { persisted } = await enrichSingleLead(...)`, and if `!persisted` returns before the Obsidian write; delete the now-redundant done write (~:534-541) because the CAS in the pipeline is the done write. claimJobs, recoverStaleRunning, failAncientRetryJobs, syncBatchStatuses and batch progress writes are untouched (they already filter on non-cancelled statuses). Documented residual: process death between the successful CAS and the lead write leaves job=done with no result; deploy-overlap can let an old-code worker move a cancelled job to retry once.

title: Review fixes: strip email secrets from campaign actions; restore lead status and retryability around the enrichment CAS; escape the HTML fallback in the sequence executor
interface: Three findings from the post-execution adversarial review. (1) lib/actions/campaigns.ts: `getEmailAccounts` (~:14-25) and `getAccountWarmupStatus` (~:364-376) select("*") from email_accounts and return rows containing `oauth_tokens`, `smtp_config`, `imap_config` to the browser (app/dashboard/campaigns/page.tsx passes them as initialAccounts). Add a private module-level helper `function withoutSecrets<T extends { oauth_tokens?: unknown; smtp_config?: unknown; imap_config?: unknown }>(row: T)` that returns a copy with those three keys removed (typed as `Omit<T, "oauth_tokens" | "smtp_config" | "imap_config">`), and map the returned arrays of both functions through it. The campaigns client only reads id, email_address, display_name, provider, status, daily_send_limit, daily_sent_count, warmup_enabled, warmup_limit, reputation_score, so nothing else changes. Other select("*") calls in the file that are used server-side only (send paths) stay. (2) lib/lead-finder/enrichment/pipeline.ts in enrichSingleLead: (a) the compare-and-swap update (~:134-140, `.in("status", ["running", "retry"]).select("id")`) must capture `{ data: claimed, error: casError }` and `throw new Error(casError.message)` when casError is set, so a transient DB failure goes down the worker's normal retry path instead of silently discarding a paid result; (b) on the `return { persisted: false }` path (~:141) first restore the lead: `await supabase.from("lf_leads").update({ status: typedLead.status }).eq("id", leadId).eq("organization_id", orgId).eq("status", "enriching")` (typedLead.status is the pre-enrichment status read at the top of the function; the `.eq("status","enriching")` guard means a lead the cancel route already reset to new, or another worker already set to qualified, is left alone); (c) in the catch after the CAS (~:186-194) change the job update from `status: "failed"` to `status: "running"` (keep last_error) so the worker's retryJob/failJob guards (status = running) apply and the job gets normal backoff/attempt accounting instead of terminal failure with no retry. (3) app/api/cron/sequence-executor/route.ts fallback catch (~:700-709): import `escapeHtml` from "@/lib/personalization/substitute" and use `escapeHtml(value)` for the `html` replacement only; the `subject` replacement stays plain. No other changes. AMENDMENT: app/dashboard/campaigns/client.tsx line ~59 declares `type EmailAccount = Database["public"]["Tables"]["email_accounts"]["Row"]`; change it to `Omit<Database["public"]["Tables"]["email_accounts"]["Row"], "oauth_tokens" | "smtp_config" | "imap_config">` so the prop and state types are truthful. No cast in campaigns.ts.
